# Solas 1.2.0
## ✨ What's new
- Watch the pond follow the seasons: flowering cherry branches and drifting sakura petals in spring, an overhanging bough in summer, crimson maple twigs and floating leaves in autumn, and snow-dusted branches with camellias, snow banks, and frost crystals in winter. The bed, water, greenery, and even the moss on the stones all take on each season's light — and every water colour stays beautiful in every season. - Make the seasons yours: choose how many twigs, camellias, and floating petals each season gets, follow the calendar or set the date each season begins, and reach everything from the new **Pond Plants** menu in the menu bar. New pond keepers pick their season during setup, watching the preview pond change as they choose. - Arrange your pond: drag lily pads, duckweed, rocks, and other plants into place, and rotate them to taste. Open **Arrange Pond** from the menu bar or Plants settings, then save, undo, reset, or cancel your changes. - New **Call fish**: click the pond and the koi rise, swim to your click — each after its own short beat — then gather and circle the spot before drifting back to their routines. On by default, and yours to switch off in the menu bar or Settings. Feeding (Option-click) still works as before. - Fish move like fish now: no more beelines. Every approach to food or to your click is an individual swoop, bodies bending through the turns, and dropping food in several places spreads the pond across all of them instead of piling everyone onto one spot. - Choose how many duckweed patches, Anubias plants, and hairgrass patches appear in your pond — in every season, Anubias included. Redesigned duckweed patches move independently of lily pads, and hidden decorations keep their positions when you bring them back. - A fresher pond floor: stones have a softer, natural mineral texture with seasonal moss, lily pads have a richer, softly cupped face, a gentle shoreline shadow gives the water real depth at its edges, and fresh ponds start with a calmer stone arrangement. If you have already arranged your stones, yours stay exactly where you put them. - Koi and mandarins have more detailed fins and fuller, shaped tails.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Fixed the pond being cropped on the wrong axis on displays whose aspect ratio differs from the main screen.

# Solas 1.1.0
## ✨ What's new
- A new welcome experience introduces your pond, ripples, fish feeding, and essential settings, with an option to activate a license or enjoy the free trial. Revisit it anytime from the menu. - Jade Depths brings a shaded slate-and-teal riverbed and soft sunlight to your pond. - Follow Device Time now offers a custom daily schedule. Choose when each weather begins, or keep Auto for the familiar day-to-night cycle. - Weather choices are easier to browse, grouped into Time of Day, Water & Depth, and Rain & Storm. - Refreshed daylight, sunset, and nighttime lighting gives each time of day a more distinct atmosphere. - Refined water currents have softer broad bands and clearer fine detail that gently fades toward the pond’s center. Highlights complement your water color and the weather’s light. - Reset All Settings in General restores your preferences to their defaults while keeping your license and trial.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Clarity now follows your slider setting consistently across all weather presets. - Current Strength now works across its full range, including values above 100%. - Settings opens on your current desktop. Closing the last Solas window removes its Dock icon while the pond keeps running.

# Solas 1.0.3
## ✨ What's new
- The pond now stays visible as a still wallpaper when your trial ends. Activate a license to resume animation. - Koi are spaced apart in the still wallpaper shown after the trial ends.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Fixed app updates failing with "An error occurred while launching the installer." - Fixed the wallpaper failing to appear or appearing late when launching with other apps open or switching desktops. - Fixed enabled plants, including lily pads, missing from paused ponds. - Fixed small fish disappearing when many koi were enabled.
